# Linux runtime library notices

These verbatim notices come from the exact source inputs of the six providers
recorded in the Linux candidate’s `BUILD_INFO.json`. `manifest.json` pins source
archives, build derivations and notice hashes. GCC runtime exception text is
included alongside its license texts; glibc’s additional LICENSES file is retained.

This inventory covers bundled dynamic libraries only. Rust dependencies, assets,
complete corresponding source/build materials and distribution verification remain
separate release requirements. Source inputs are available in the local Nix store;
this directory does not claim a complete source distribution or legal clearance.
